title: Test: Agent Security
summary: Check what you learned across the whole chapter.

questions.q: The section **Attacks Through Permitted Operations** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A defense is evaluated by system effects at the protected sink on whole eligible episodes, not by model text, and its overhead is priced in cost per accepted task.

questions.q: The section **Delegated Identity and Credential Brokering** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Human approval binds to a digest of the canonical, host-resolved action, is presented out of band with the agent's explanation labeled untrusted, and is re-verified with its preconditions immediately before dispatch.
